personas.description: Full four-section SOAP note for home-managed tonsillitis with explicit safety-netting (required because managedAtHome=yes) — expect complete / 100%.

subjective.presentingComplaint: Three days of sore throat and painful swallowing
subjective.historyOfPresentingComplaint: Gradual onset, no cough, mild fever at home, eating less but drinking well.

plan.safetyNetting: Advised to seek urgent review for stridor, drooling, inability to swallow fluids, or worsening despite antibiotics.
